external_collaboration.evidence_quote: RGSL has opened Erasmus cooperation with Deusto University in Bilbao, Spain. The cooperation covers both student and teacher exchange. Each university will receive EU funds to finance the travel and accommodation for their students and teachers during their stay at the other university, the length of which is variable up to one semester.

To improve international collaboration RGSL has joined University of Innsbruck, University of Genoa, University of Groningen, University of Valencia, University of Zagreb and IPR Verlag in the EU funded project entitled Unalex – Multilingual information on the uniform interpretation of the instruments of judicial cooperation in civil matters. The project kick-off meeting took place 25-26 January 2016 in Munich, and RGSL was represented by Peter Gjortler, Director of the International Development

Other activity RGSL took part was European Law Moot Court on 11-14 February 2016. University of Athens hosted one of the regional finals of the European Law Moot Court, and RGSL was represented on the bench of judges by Peter Gjortler, Director of the International Development Department. The regional final was won by a team of students from University of Gothenburg in Sweden, with London School of Economics taking second place. Rīgas Juridisko augstskolu šīgada sacensībās pārstāvēja seši studenti - Dmitro Čibisovs (Dmytro Chybisov), Iveta Gedus, Linda Germova, Natia Lapiašvili (Natia Lapiashvili), Irina Oļevska un Kasapars Ratkevičs. Komandas trenere bija RJA asociētā profesore Gaļina Žukova, kurai palīdzēja zvērināta advokāta palīdze Maija Volkova („Lejiņš, Torgāns un partneri”).
RJA ir pateicīga advokātu birojam „Liepa, Skopiņa/Borenius” un advokātu birojam „Sorainen” par sniegto finansiālo atbalstu komandas dalībai šī gada sacensībās.

Biznesa modeli izstrādāja RJA Tiesības un bizness bakalaura programmas studente Linda Kokare, Kristīne Blumberga (Banku Augstskola) un Aleksandrs Savaļjevs (Banku Augstskola), savukārt, tehnoloģiskos risinājumus veidoja Eduards Ruzga (UniWEB), Renārs Vilnis (Latvijas Universitāte) un Askars Vectors (Tilde). Par dizainu rūpējās Kristaps Elsiņš (Softkom). Startup Weekend piektdien, š.g. 17. janvārī, sākās ar komandu veidošanu. Jau svētdien, pēc 54 stundu ilga darba un konsultācijām ar dažādiem noz
